description: Read the human-written notes (הערות) from across the CRM — the same feed as the in-app 'Notes Hub'. Aggregates notes attached to contacts (from the chat timeline), leads and cases (פניות). Filter by source ('contact' | 'lead' | 'case'), a date range (dateFrom/dateTo, yyyy-MM-dd; defaults to the last 30 days), the author (userId), or a free-text search inside the note body. Paginated. Each item includes: note, entityType, entityId, contactId, contactName, entityName, createdOn, createdById, createdByName. Use gambot_get_entity_notes to read the notes of ONE specific contact/lead/case.

dateFrom.description: Start date yyyy-MM-dd (defaults to 30 days ago when both dates omitted).

search.description: Free-text match inside the note body.

source.description: Filter by origin. Omit for all sources.

userId.description: Only notes written by this org user (their uID).

name: gambot_list_notes
title: List / search notes
